ways.title: Three ways to learn.
ways.examBody: Targeted SPM revision, past-year drills and answering technique that turns effort into marks.
ways.oneBody: Full attention on one student — lessons paced to how they actually learn.
ways.doorBody: Home-visit tutoring at a time that fits your week, so there's no travel after a long school day.

schedule.intro: Indicative weekly availability. Message on WhatsApp to confirm a time.
schedule.note: Times are a guide — door-to-door slots depend on your location.

faq.a1: Mainly lower secondary Science and Form 4–5 / SPM subjects. Message me with your child's level and I'll tell you honestly if I'm the right fit.
faq.a2: I travel to your home for the lesson, so there's no extra driving after school. Coverage and timing depend on your area — ask me to check.
faq.q3: Do you teach one-to-one or in groups?
faq.a3: Both. One-to-one gives the most focus; small groups are available for some subjects and time slots.
faq.q4: What languages do you teach in?
faq.a4: Lessons can be in English, Bahasa Melayu or Mandarin, matched to what the student is most comfortable with.
faq.a5: Rates depend on subject, level and format. Message on WhatsApp for current pricing — no obligation.
faq.a6: Send a WhatsApp message with the student's level and subjects. We'll arrange a first session and take it from there.

about.body1: Teacher Thomas has tutored Malaysian secondary students since 2014, helping them turn confusion into confidence across the sciences, maths and languages.
about.body2: The Tt Learning System is built on a simple idea — study with awareness, not stress. Lessons focus on understanding first, then exam technique, so results follow naturally.

contact.intro: Message on WhatsApp or follow along on Instagram. No forms, no fuss — just a quick chat about what your child needs.

footer.tagline: Study with awareness. Improve with ease.
